import_policy: Apply the supersession map and the per-claim identity/date/type gates. A sighting is not a start, a transfer deadline is not execution, and a null end is not proof of current survival. Held candidates, leads and negative checks do not become historical events.
source_count_policy: Catalogue rows include screened candidates, indices, failed retrievals and guards; they are not all accepted sources. Formal claims include corroboration, prior integrations and held candidates; they are not all new dates or closed WANTED items.
preservation: Every component retains its exact original nested path; source statuses, claim gates and the supersession map are preserved. This is a corrected complete data handoff, not permission to bulk-import held or review-only claims.
